genxml.title: per-pipe select and Z-buffer registers of the R3xx-class FireGL boards
genxml.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0
genxml.doc: Per-pipe destination select, occlusion counters and the hierarchical Z RAM of the R3xx-class boards. The chip has two pixel pipes; the registers below decide which of them a write reaches.

struct.name: SU_REG_DEST
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 45
struct.doc: Selects the pixel pipes that receive register writes. Writes reach both pipes unless this register restricts them.

struct.name: ZB_BW_CNTL
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 92
struct.doc: Z buffer bandwidth control. Hierarchical Z is switched on and off here.

struct.name: ZB_HIZ_OFFSET
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 95
struct.doc: Base of the hierarchical Z RAM in each pipe, in dwords. The Z RAM address of pixel (x, y) is the base in bits 16:3, plus the Y block index times the pitch, plus the X block index. One dword holds an 8-bit Z value for each of four 4x4 blocks.

struct.name: ZB_HIZ_WRINDEX
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 96
struct.doc: Dword index for writes to the Z RAM data port. Each write to the data port advances it by two dwords, because the data goes to both pipes.

struct.name: ZB_HIZ_DWORD
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 95
struct.doc: Z RAM data port. One write carries four 8-bit values for a 2x2 group of 4x4 blocks; the byte for block (X, Y) sits at bit 16 times X bit 2 plus 8 times Y bit 2.

struct.name: ZB_HIZ_RDINDEX
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 96
struct.doc: Dword index for reads of the Z RAM data port. Each read advances it by two dwords.

struct.name: ZB_HIZ_PITCH
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 96
struct.doc: Row pitch of the hierarchical Z RAM, used with the base to address a block.

struct.name: ZB_ZPASS_DATA
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 97-98
struct.doc: Count of samples that passed the Z test since this register was last written. A write sets the count to the value written. Each pipe keeps its own count.

struct.name: ZB_ZPASS_ADDR
struct.from: AMD Radeon R3xx 3D Register Reference, revision 1.0, p. 97
struct.doc: Writing a dword address makes each selected pipe write its occlusion count to memory at that address. A write that reaches both pipes makes both write to the same address in no guaranteed order, so a driver selects one pipe at a time.
